tools.name: list_gpu_families
tools.description:
List every GPU family tracked on cheap-gpus.com, with VRAM, live cheapest
        on-demand price (USD per GPU-hour), and how many providers currently offer it.

tools.name: cheapest_gpu
tools.description:
Cheapest current rental offers for one GPU family (e.g. "H100", "RTX 5090",
        "b200"), in USD per GPU-hour, cheapest first, one row per provider.
        pricing_type is "on_demand" (default; can't be interrupted) or "spot"
        (cheaper, the provider can reclaim the machine). limit: 1-10.

tools.name: gpu_price_history
tools.description:
Daily price history for one GPU family: each day's median across providers
        of each provider's cheapest offer (USD per GPU-hour). days: 1-90.

tools.name: find_model
tools.description:
Search the LLM catalog by name (e.g. "deepseek v3", "gpt-oss", "llama 70b").
        Returns model slugs to pass to cheapest_model_route / gpus_needed_for_model,
        most widely offered first. limit: 1-10.

tools.name: cheapest_model_route
gpu_price_forecast
tools.description:
Market-implied future rental price for one GPU family (USD per GPU-hour), from
        prediction markets (Kalshi, Polymarket) and ICE futures, plus today's compute-index
        benchmarks and cheap-gpus.com's own current median price. Covers H100, H200, B200,
        A100 and RTX 5090.

tools.name: gpus_needed_for_model
tools.description:

        and the cheapest rental setups for it right now. quant is one of: fp16, bf16, fp8,
        mxfp8, int8, q6, fp6, q5, q4km, nvfp4, awq, mxfp4, gptq, int4, q3, q2, iq2, iq1.
